description: Fail-open authorization: watchlist check catch block returns all users as unblocked (false) when the watchlist service errors, allowing blocked or locked users to proceed.
Cloudflare Turnstile bot-protection check is skipped (returns success:true) when CLOUDFLARE_TURNSTILE_SECRET is unset or NEXT_PUBLIC_IS_E2E is set, bypassing verification.
Production CSP script-src includes 'unsafe-inline' https: alongside nonce/strict-dynamic; legacy browsers lacking strict-dynamic honor unsafe-inline, weakening XSS protection.
Vercel webhook signature verification uses HMAC-SHA1 (createHmac 'sha1', webhookSecret); SHA-1 is a deprecated weak hash. Comparison itself is timing-safe via timingSafeEqual.
HelpScout webhook signature uses HMAC-SHA1 (weak hash) and reuses the global CALENDSO_ENCRYPTION_KEY as the HMAC secret instead of a dedicated signing key.
HelpScout HMAC signature compared with non-constant-time != (hsSignature !== calculatedSig), leaking timing; vercel-webhook.guard.ts uses timingSafeEqual for the same task.
CALENDSO_ENCRYPTION_KEY reused across 3+ crypto purposes: AES-256-CBC key (link, TOTP 2FA, calendar creds), JWT HS256 login secret (getServerSideProps), HMAC-SHA1 secret (helpscout).
Legacy unauthenticated AES-256-CBC (ALGORITHM=aes256) stays in active use for credential and 2FA encryption while a modern AES-256-GCM keyring with key rotation exists in crypto/keyring.ts.
